title: Finite maximum settings are displayed as infinite after the runtime-cap hotfix
root_cause: The .10 implementation deliberately emitted infinite technology prototypes for positive maximum settings and enforced the selection only through control-stage queue filtering and technology disabling. Factorio therefore displayed the prototype as infinite even when the runtime cap blocked further research.

finite_prototype_experiment.transition: infinite cap to finite cap 5 with completed level 8 and active progress
finite_prototype_experiment.decision: finite prototypes rejected because public .10 saves have no preexisting state journal and cannot be recovered before control is returned
